integrity: Exact finite acyclic matching, full signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz enumeration and integer character transform are reproduced by embedded standard-library checker; verified by self-review only; no independent validation is claimed. Novelty is subject to unindexed equivalent computations.
scientific_limitations: Only the 27-point three-coordinate ternary Hamming space, inclusive radius two, and rational/complex action of its 27 translations. Does not compute integral group-ring lattice, full wreath-product character, or general-alphabet equivariant homology. The nonequivariant wedge of 46 three-spheres is previously established.
title: Complete ternary translation character of the radius-two Hamming Rips complex
